description: Manage layer visibility, opacity, colormaps, and rescaling with event bus architecture.

descriptionFull.title: A unified layer management tool that shows all layers with their visibility state, opacity controls, and for COG-enabled layers, colormap selection and rescale controls. This tool uses the event bus architecture exclusively for communication with core modules.

name: LayerManager

components.name: Display on Start
components.description: Whether the tool should be displayed when the mission loads.

components.name: Show Only Visible
components.description: Only show layers that are currently visible.

components.name: Forecast Runs
components.description: How many of the newest model runs a forecast layer offers in its Model run dropdown. A layer's own variables.forecast.runs overrides this.
